# HomeNet UI package

`homenet-ui-0.3.2.tgz` was packed from `packages/ui` at HomeNet revision `6696fcbf8bd2905ca692da538535e7f3bd3930d3`. The package was built from a temporary copy with TypeScript 5.9.3 and Tailwind CSS 4.3.4; no sibling checkout is needed to install or build this application. The source package does not declare a software license in its package metadata or provide a repository LICENSE file. Font license notices are included in the archive under `dist/fonts`.
